title: Linux activity correlation pack
notes: Covers high-signal Linux access, privilege, persistence, service-tampering, and operator-tool execution activity.

stream_rules.title: Linux SSH Login Failure Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Review source addresses, destination host, and whether the failures match a maintenance window or active brute-force behavior.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.sshd' and event.type == 'ssh_login_failure' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and not event.original icontains '192.168.1.102' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: Linux Root SSH Login
stream_rules.operator_action: Confirm whether direct root SSH access is expected on the asset. Treat unexpected root logins as immediate privilege and hardening review items.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.sshd' and event.type == 'linux_root_ssh_login' and not host.name icontains 'e2e-host-' and not log_source icontains 'e2e-host-' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: Linux Sudo To Root Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Check the command series, operator identity, and whether the privilege usage matches the current change window or is becoming excessive.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.sudo' and event.type == 'sudo_command' and user.target.name == 'root' and not (user.name == 'rdegon' and (host.name == 'siem-ingest' or host.name == 'siem-processing' or host.name == 'siem-storage' or host.name == 'siem-web' or host.name == 'siem-transport' or host.name == 'siem-standby-transport') and (process.command_line icontains 'python3 deploy/' or process.command_line icontains '/opt/siem/siem-solution' or process.command_line icontains 'systemctl restart siem-' or process.command_line icontains 'systemctl is-active siem-' or process.command_line icontains 'journalctl -u siem-' or process.command_line icontains 'clickhouse-client' or process.command_line icontains 'kafka-topics.sh' or process.command_line icontains 'kafka-consumer-groups.sh' or process.command_line icontains 'apt-get install' or process.command_line icontains '/proc/')) and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: Linux Cron Modified
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect the changed cron entry, owning account, and recently executed commands. Unexpected cron edits often indicate persistence attempts.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Linux Cron Modified
id: sigma-linux-cron-modified
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: auditd
detection:
  selection:
    event.provider: linux.auditd
    event.type: linux_cron_modified
  condition: selection
level: high

stream_rules.title: Linux Sudoers Modified
stream_rules.operator_action: Validate the sudoers change against change control. If unexpected, revert immediately and inspect privilege escalation activity around the same period.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Linux Sudoers Modified
id: sigma-linux-sudoers-modified
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: auditd
detection:
  selection:
    event.provider: linux.auditd
    event.type: linux_sudoers_modified
  condition: selection
level: high

stream_rules.title: Linux Systemd Unit Modified
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect the changed unit file, recent restarts, and whether the modification aligns with approved deployment activity or persistence attempts.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.auditd' and event.type == 'linux_systemd_unit_modified' and (event.original icontains '/etc/systemd/system/' or event.original icontains '/lib/systemd/system/' or event.original icontains '/usr/lib/systemd/system/') and not event.original icontains '.dpkg-' and not event.original icontains 'dpkg-tmp' and not event.original icontains 'dpkg-new' and not event.original icontains 'dpkg-old' and not event.original icontains 'nametype=PARENT' and not event.original icontains 'apt.systemd.daily' and not event.original icontains 'unattended-upgrade' and not event.original icontains '/tmp/apt-dpkg-install' and not process.command_line icontains 'apt-dpkg-install' and not process.command_line icontains '/usr/bin/dpkg' and not process.command_line icontains '/usr/bin/apt' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: Linux Security-Critical Service Disabled
stream_rules.operator_action: Confirm which service was disabled and why. Unexpected disablement of telemetry or security-relevant services should be escalated immediately.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Linux Security-Critical Service Disabled
id: sigma-linux-security-critical-service-disabled
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: auditd
detection:
  selection:
    event.provider: linux.auditd
    event.type: linux_systemd_service_disabled
  condition: selection
level: high

stream_rules.title: Linux SSH Invalid User Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Review the source addresses and target host. Persistent invalid-user probes usually indicate perimeter password spraying or opportunistic SSH recon.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.sshd' and event.type == 'ssh_invalid_user' and source.ip != '192.168.1.102' and not event.original icontains '192.168.1.102' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

stream_rules.title: Linux Authorized Keys Modified
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect the account, file path, and surrounding SSH activity. Unexpected authorized_keys edits are often persistence or lateral-access setup.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Linux Authorized Keys Modified
id: sigma-linux-authorized-keys-modified
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: auditd
detection:
  selection:
    event.provider: linux.auditd
    event.type: linux_authorized_keys_modified
  condition: selection
level: high

stream_rules.title: Linux Passwd Or Shadow Access
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect which process touched passwd or shadow data and whether it belongs to expected account-management activity. Unexpected reads often indicate credential harvesting.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Linux Passwd Or Shadow Access
id: sigma-linux-passwd-or-shadow-access
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: auditd
detection:
  selection:
    event.provider: linux.auditd
    event.type: linux_passwd_shadow_access
  condition: selection
level: high

stream_rules.title: Linux Execution From Temporary Paths
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect command line, parent process, and recent downloads. Execution from temporary paths often indicates staging of ad hoc tooling or malware.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.auditd' and event.type == 'linux_exec_from_tmp' and not event.original icontains '/tmp/apt-dpkg-install' and not event.original icontains 'apt-dpkg-install' and not event.original icontains 'dpkg --status-fd' and not process.command_line icontains '/tmp/apt-dpkg-install' and not process.command_line icontains 'apt-dpkg-install' and not process.command_line icontains '/usr/bin/dpkg' and not process.command_line icontains '/usr/bin/apt' and not user.target.name icontains '/tmp/apt-dpkg-install' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:' and not tags icontains 'benchmark' and not tags icontains 'synthetic' and not tags icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'e2e' and not log_source icontains 'e2e' and not host.name icontains 'assignment-full' and not log_source icontains 'assignment-full' and not host.name icontains 'validation' and not log_source icontains 'validation')

stream_rules.title: Linux Audit Rules Cleared
stream_rules.operator_action: Treat cleared audit rules as a likely defense-evasion attempt unless there is an approved maintenance action covering telemetry reconfiguration.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Linux Audit Rules Cleared
id: sigma-linux-audit-rules-cleared
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: auditd
detection:
  selection:
    event.provider: linux.auditd
    event.type: linux_audit_rules_cleared
  condition: selection
level: high

stream_rules.title: Linux Firewall Disabled
stream_rules.operator_action: Confirm whether the firewall disablement matches a controlled change. Unexpected disablement should be treated as an immediate containment and hardening issue.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Linux Firewall Disabled
id: sigma-linux-firewall-disabled
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux

level: high

stream_rules.title: Linux Remote Access Or Reverse Shell Activity
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect the binary, network destination, and user context. Unexpected remote-access tooling or reverse-shell indicators should be escalated immediately.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Linux Remote Access Or Reverse Shell Activity
id: sigma-linux-remote-access-or-reverse-shell-activity

logsource:

detection:

    event.provider: linux.auditd
    event.type:

  condition: selection
level: high

stream_rules.title: Linux Audit Configuration Changed
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect changes to auditd configuration or rules. Unexpected audit reconfiguration should be treated as defense evasion until proven otherwise.

stream_rules.operator_action: Review which SSH setting changed and whether it widens access, weakens authentication, or supports persistence.

stream_rules.title: Linux Logging Configuration Changed
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect rsyslog configuration drift. Changes that suppress forwarding or modify routing can hide attacker activity from SIEM.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:

stream_rules.title: Linux User Lifecycle Change
stream_rules.operator_action: Validate account creation, deletion, password change, or unexpected addition to admin groups against approved administrative work.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:
title: Linux User Lifecycle Change
id: sigma-linux-user-lifecycle-change
status: experimental
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: auditd
detection:
  selection:
    event.type:
      - linux_user_created
      - linux_user_deleted
      - linux_password_changed
      - linux_user_added_to_admin_group
  condition: selection
level: medium

stream_rules.title: Linux Download Utility Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect repeated curl or wget usage together with destination, user context, and subsequent execution to determine whether tooling or payload staging is happening.

stream_rules.title: Linux Network Tool Or Packet Capture Activity
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect the operator, destination, and command line. Unexpected use of nc, socat, tcpdump, or tshark should be triaged quickly on production assets.

stream_rules.operator_action: Review module load or unload attempts and kernel parameter changes. Unexpected changes may support stealth, persistence, or traffic interception.

stream_rules.title: Linux Capability Or Setuid Tampering
stream_rules.operator_action: Inspect which file gained capabilities or setuid bits. Unexpected changes often indicate privilege-escalation staging or persistence.

stream_rules.title: Linux LD Preload Modified
stream_rules.operator_action: Escalate unexpected ld.so.preload changes immediately. They are strongly associated with userland rootkits and stealthy persistence.

stream_rules.title: Linux Pkexec Execution
stream_rules.operator_action: Review the caller, target command, and surrounding privilege activity. Unexpected pkexec usage is high signal on server assets.

stream_rules.title: Linux Data Compression Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Review bulk archive creation together with the destination path and adjacent transfer activity. Repeated compression may indicate staging for exfiltration.
stream_rules.sigma_yaml:

stream_rules.title: Linux System Recon Burst
stream_rules.operator_action: Review the recon commands, user context, and whether the burst belongs to expected service health checks. Escalate unknown interactive or remote-origin recon.
stream_rules.expr: (event.provider == 'linux.auditd' and event.type == 'linux_system_recon' and not event.original icontains 'key="openclaw_send"' and not event.original icontains '/usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw' and not process.command_line icontains '/usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw' and not tags icontains 'allowlist:')

batch_rules.title: Linux Persistence Change Review
batch_rules.description: Batch review of cron, sudoers, SSH, and systemd change activity across Linux assets.

batch_rules.title: Linux Administrative Tool Review
batch_rules.description: Batch review of admin-tool execution such as curl, wget, nc, tcpdump, pkexec, sysctl, and archive creation across Linux assets.
